title: Hay for the Long Winter

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: When the snow covers the fields, the cows can't find grass. They eat hay we saved in summer.

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: Would you please share this hay fairly? Every cow should have the same.

steps.speaker: hannah
steps.prompt: Share the hay so every cow has the same.

older.prompt: Share the hay fairly among five cows. Any left over goes in the spare bowl.

feedback.all_good: Fair shares: {n} bundles each! Warm, full cows.

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Thank you! Each cow has the same, so nobody goes hungry on a cold night.

journal_line: I shared hay fairly among Mrs. Hannah's cows.
